messages:
maria_cs: Hi team — kickoff for EchoLight onboarding tomorrow 10am PT (Zoom link in calendar). Main goals: get them ingesting data, validate 1st prototype flow, and surface any security blockers before EOW. Can folks call out owners for stakeholder touchpoints and a quick risk shoutout?

tara_success: I can own the week-1 enablement and run the product demo. I'll prepare a 30/60/90 checklist.

ben_eng: I can take data onboarding + infra checks. Need to confirm whether EchoLight wants S3 pulls or streaming. @maria_cs do we have their data schema yet?

maria_cs: Not yet — they said they'll share a sample on the call. If they do S3 we'll need a presigned workflow; streaming will need websocket config. Ben, estimate 2-3 dev hours for S3 path setup and 4-6 for streaming.

sam_ops: I'll handle access & network: VPC peering questions and KMS scope. Flagging renewal risk: EchoLight requested a 12mo commitment but they have legal on a tight timeline. If we hit onboarding delays >2 weeks that could push renewal talk to Q4. Recommend an escrow plan (short-term dedicated capacity) if they want predictability.

olivia_ps: I'll own success criteria + feedback capture. Proposed SLAs for the pilot: 95% on-time inference under 300ms p50, and 3 sample queries/day matching expected semantic accuracy for 7/10 prompts. Also want to run a 10q feedback survey after week 1.

maria_cs: Love the concrete metrics. Quick agenda for tomorrow:
```
- Intros + stakeholders (10m)
- Data handoff & infra requirements (15m)
- Product demo + expected flows (20m)
- Success metrics & reporting cadence (10m)
- Risks & next steps (5m)
```

ben_eng: One more infra note: we might recommend quantized model variant if latency budget is tight. I'll bring perf numbers for the recommended instance types.

tara_success: Training/workshop plan — propose a 1.5h workshop in week 1 for devs + product (hands-on with SDK + sample prompts). I can draft materials and a recording.

sam_ops: Security question for legal: do they require a SOC2 attestation for sandbox logs? If yes, our Private deployment checklist applies. I'll ping legal after the call.

maria_cs: Great — owners recap: Tara = enablement & demo, Ben = data + infra, Sam = network & security, Olivia = metrics & feedback. I'll take meeting notes and share the first 7-day runbook after the call.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite scheduled for 1776550000 (tomorrow 10:00 PT).

ben_eng: Quick ask — can someone confirm the contact who will share the schema? Need email to whitelist.

maria_cs: EchoLight rep is @jared (they added him to the calendar). I'll DM to nudge schema ahead of the meeting.

olivia_ps: Also will set up a simple Notion page for outcome tracking and a shared feedback doc (template: 10 short questions + NPS). Will post link in #customer-success after the call.

tara_success: If legal or procurement slows things, propose a short pilot MSA (30 days) to keep momentum. We can escalate renewal terms after pilot success.

sam_ops: Noted. Flagging a medium risk: if legal needs cross-border data controls we might need additional timeline. Will surface immediately if raised.

maria_cs: Thanks all — short pre-call checklist for tomorrow: 1) EchoLight sample dataset or schema, 2) list of reviewers for security, 3) primary use cases (3x core flows), 4) stakeholder emails for follow-ups. I'll put this in the invite body now.

ben_eng: 👍 I'll prepare a minimal S3 example command to demo presigned workflow:
```
aws s3 presign s3://echolight-bucket/sample.json --expires-in 3600
```

olivia_ps: +1. I'll also add the week-1 feedback survey link to the runbook after the call.

maria_cs: Perfect — see you all tomorrow. If anything blocks before then, drop it here and we'll triage. :rocket:
